mobile_crew_mode_applies_next: A change applies from the next tool call, including one that is waiting now.
mobile_crew_mode_ask_detail: Asks you before every tool call.
mobile_crew_mode_bypass_detail: Every tool call runs without asking. Protected paths still ask.
mobile_crew_mode_changed: {name} is now in {mode} mode. It applies from the next tool call.
mobile_crew_mode_edits_detail: File edits in its worktree run without asking. Everything else asks.
mobile_crew_mode_error_bypass_disabled: Bypass is turned off for this crew. Turn it on in the crew settings to use it.
mobile_crew_mode_error_forbidden: Only you can change a permission mode, from Atlas Desktop, Atlas Mobile or your linked Telegram chat.
mobile_crew_mode_error_no_access: This phone isn't allowed to answer approvals or change modes. Allow it in this phone's access settings in Atlas on your computer.
mobile_crew_mode_error_unsupported_engin: {engine} has no approval channel, so it always runs without asking. Only Bypass applies to it.
mobile_crew_mode_locked_semantics: Permission mode: {mode}. It can't be changed.
mobile_crew_mode_no_channel: This engine has no approval channel.
